false_positives.definition: Each item is an exact (guid, subevent, actor, direction, L1 value) tuple.
false_positives.interpretation: Shared errors are observed dependence, not proof of its cause or a formal correlation estimate.

false_negatives.definition: Each item is an exact (guid, subevent, actor, direction, L1 value) tuple.
false_negatives.interpretation: Shared errors are observed dependence, not proof of its cause or a formal correlation estimate.

consensus_relative_to_veto.interpretation: CONSENSUS adds B-and-C agreement omitted by A; it is a superset of VETO.

union_oracle_candidate_recall.interpretation: An oracle with gold access deletes every UNION false positive and keeps every UNION true positive. This measures the directed-label candidate ceiling, not achieved verifier performance or an expected future score.

analysis_type: post-hoc explanation of already frozen results; not a new selection or validation stage
offline_analysis_repair: Initial analysis parser required complete gold event rows and stopped before writing output. Repaired to match the official sparse-gold convention: omitted gold events/actors have empty sets. Prediction coverage remains strict. No predictions, model requests, official scores or primary method changed.
limitations: Same-model prompts share errors; observed overlap does not establish why errors occurred.
100 sampled events are not full DEV or an unseen test set; prior DEV analyses exist.
Do not change the frozen primary, prompts, gate, or thresholds based on these findings.

input_representativeness.plan_change: Before any model calls, replace the earlier proposed 100-of-508-successes sample with a fixed hash-selected 100 from all 1526 supplied DEV events. The old completion pool was nonrandom and favored completed calls. Historical results are compared only on the resulting intersection, never by replacing sampled events.
interpretation: This describes observed input coverage; similar marginal distributions do not prove representativeness.
A hash ranking with a fixed pre-outcome seed is a reproducible pseudorandom selection; do not reroll after viewing inputs or labels.
Under genuine equal-probability event sampling, expanded TP/FP/FN totals are unbiased; their F1 ratio is not exactly unbiased.
100 events do not cover all 177 articles or guarantee rare-label coverage. This is not a full-DEV result.
Exact TRAIN body overlap is an input diagnostic, not evidence that a particular model memorized those articles.
